Definition: from G2543 and G1065; and yet indeed, i.e. although really:--nevertheless, though.
BiblicalUsage: Kaitoige is 'and yet indeed' — a single use, in the note that Jesus Himself baptized not, but His disciples did, though the crowds were coming to Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the verse quietly honours the disciples' share in the work: the Lord received the crowds, and His servants did the baptizing.
